description:
Outcome: Owner accepts the agreed first version, from BRIEF.md and owner answers.
Scope: Complete demonstration and operating instructions. Excludes: SMS.
Criteria: Door adds two visitors with the same first name; 3-6 repairer clients take without duplicate claims and finish; board shows first names/status/reference and refreshes every ten seconds; outage recovery works; all views and storage expire according to C1 ruling; B2 startup/readiness documented.
Artifact: Working app, automated/manual evidence, deployment/timezone/retention instructions including any explicitly accepted operating limitations.
Acceptance: Owner records acceptance against all criteria.
Behaviour: Failed criteria remain open.
Verification: Demonstration plus test evidence and explicit owner acceptance. Prerequisites: Q3 operator controls, V1 board page, V2 auto-refresh. Assumptions: trusted LAN deployment.
Stage-1 limitation: ordinary checkpoint ticket, not a technically enforced owner gate.
Setup label: C2.
title: Checkpoint: first-version acceptance
